capabilities: Open a card-view quick switcher via a command
Search contents and file names of the 10 most recently opened files
Search all file names with a ' prefix
Pick 10 random files with a ; prefix
extras: README only covers the three search modes and the command to open the switcher; no screenshots or configuration details.
intentEvidence: This plugin provides a quick switcher with card view.
problem: The default quick switcher shows a plain list, making it harder to visually scan and pick files.
summary: A quick switcher that opens files from a card view, with recent, normal, and random search modes.
